population: Unchanged11565 identity-linked Jamendo rows and713 artist/album components. Existing five outer component hash folds; exactly3 happy/not_happy votes eligible, all disagreements retained. No original prediction file used for calibration.
inner_roles: Within each outer training partition SHA256('jamendo-calibration-inner-v1'+NUL+outer_fold_decimal+NUL+component_id_decimal), full digest big-endian integer modulo5==0 assigns calibration, otherwise fit. All tracks in a component retain same role. Outer fold query components never fit or calibrate. Roles assigned without tags or votes.
base: Existing component-weighted fractional BernoulliNB alpha1. Vocabulary, class prior and present/absent likelihoods learned only from eligible inner-fit rows. Calibration and query vectors use this vocabulary. No refit after calibration. Same inner-fit NB supplies uncalibrated comparator and calibration input; same-fit human prior is contextual comparator. Previous full-outer-training NB outcomes are not a matched comparator.

calibrator.objective: Sum normalized equal-calibration-component row weights times [logaddexp(0,a*logit(p)+b)-y*(a*logit(p)+b)] +0.01/2*((a-1)^2+b^2), y=happy_votes/3. Each eligible calibration component has equal mass, each row equal within component; all weights sum1. Ridge shrinks toward identity, not zero.
calibrator.optimizer: scipy.optimize.minimize L-BFGS-B, analytic gradient, x0=[1,0], bounds[(0,None),(None,None)], ftol1e-12,gtol1e-8,maxiter500,maxls50. No alternative optimizer, restart or penalty search. Nonfinite/nonconverged result fails stage.
calibrator.degeneracy: If fewer than2 eligible calibration components or total weighted happy mass==0 or not-happy mass==0, use identity a=1,b=0 with explicit reason; no threshold adjustment. No eligible inner-fit rows: all arms abstain with no_inner_fit reason. Empty NB vocabulary still yields fitted prior and may calibrate. Constant logits allowed; fixed ridge makes objective strictly convex.
calibrator.identity_application: Identity fallback returns original NB p exactly without clipping; a fitted calibrator clips p only for logit transform. All comparisons retain original NB probabilities and unchanged source votes.

primary: Calibrated minus inner-fit NB component-equal individual-vote Brier. Individual-vote loss=p^2-2*p*y+y. Within each eligible predicted query component average all eligible row losses, then equal-component mean. Negative delta is improvement. No new significance or confidence interval.
secondary: Component-equal and track-weighted fractional binary log loss using metric-only probability clipping1e-12
Mean-target squared error and y*(1-y) vote-disagreement noise reported separately; noise is not calibration error
All five folds, paired per-component proper-score differences, missing eligible predictions and calibration fallback counts
reliability: Fixed10 equal-width bins[0,.1),...,[.9,1],no adaptive binning. For each arm report raw row/component counts and sum of weights, weighted mean prediction and weighted mean happy fraction; row weight1/n_eligible_predicted_rows_in_its_query_component. Empty bins null means. Descriptive aggregate reliability, no fitted recalibration or ECE target selection.
coverage: All nominated rows recorded once. Ineligible votes retained with reason and no target/prediction. Eligible no-fit rows remain in coverage and explicit missing-score counts, never zero-impute a proper score. All three arms share prediction availability. If any eligible queries abstain, scored metrics are explicitly conditional and cannot be described as full-cohort improvement. Identity fallbacks remain predictions, separately counted.
reporting: Per-fold fit/calibration/query nominated+eligible rows and component counts, vocabulary size, weighted calibration class masses, calibrator parameters/status/iterations/objective, all predictions and raw votes, identity ledger roles, version/hash/runtime receipts. Declare any constant-input or empty-vocabulary case.
verification: External prepared-seal pin; original source/cohort/code/version guards unchanged. Freeze exact new source,protocol,dependency versions and roles before fits. Independent replay uses separate numeric implementation for base parameters, convex calibration solution, every query probability and metric. Mutation tests must show outer labels and calibration labels never alter base model; outer labels cannot alter calibrator.
stages: One freeze/identity-role stage, one fivefold evaluation stage, one deterministic replay stage; each unchanged120seconds. Synthetic tests only before approved source seal. No new acquisition or baseline identical rerun.
interpretation: Already inspected outer folds are diagnostic, not fresh independent confirmation. This is metadata prediction of human happiness votes, not acoustic similarity, artist-style or recommendation usefulness. Annotator identities/selection, upstream global vocabulary preprocessing and unknown duplicate artists remain limitations. No model promotion or additional tuning if negative.
rights: Local noncommercial research only. Retained data/models/per-track predictions remain CC-BY-NC-SA4 with MTG-Jamendo attribution, never MIT serving artifacts. Source/protocol and restrained aggregate results may follow existing research recipe publication; no raw or per-track research artifacts published. No audio,downloads,new dependencies,paid services or deployment.
